# Checks

The suites of cl_kit's modules: programs compiled against one module (and what it imports) only, run in a throwaway home
(`Checks/.work/<suite>/home`), printing `FAIL` per failed check and a count at the end. `run.sh` builds the modules once with
testing on (`Checks/.work/modules`; addressprivacy builds its own, apart) and runs every suite; each app runs the same script on its vendored copy.

```
Checks/run.sh [core|runs|auth|claudesignin|nokeychain|addressprivacy|all] [--no-build]
```

| Suite | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `core` | ProfileCore (`Core/`) compiled against the library alone (Foundation only): the exact seat comparisons, the case-blind one where the app uses it, the one seat comparison (`compare`: seat, seat not known, different), and identities known by address and organisation, the standby accounts' order and the picks (`best`, `mostRecent`; an address-only account never picked), a crafted standby entry read with a given clock, the tidy standby list, fresh (thresholds as parameters), full and the blocker (data only), full in two modes (acts, display), times in words with a fixed calendar (Gregorian under a Buddhist, Japanese or Hijri calendar; the caller's time zone), the colour level at its edges, `Login.parse` (a token, hex output, five unreadable forms) and `UsageParser` (both reply shapes, a model's own limit, credits, dates, the profile's address), the saved JSON keys of Seat, SeatID, StandbyAccount and Credits, the headline, the display value and the reader's state machine, the status record (its codec: a round trip, an older record, unknown keys, the drawable clamp), `StatusAges`, `ProfileLook`'s defaults, the display value from a record and `StatusFace` (fresh, old, full and full but old, a split, signed out, another account, no record, the window mark, the elapsed shares); a lint that `Core/` imports Foundation only and holds no app's paths, files, words (a full limit's names and times, the usage source) or global state, and that its comments name no app's screens or files |
| `runs` | Runs (`Run/`) compiled against it alone (Foundation), with harmless stand-ins (`sh`, `sleep`, `true`, `false`, `echo`, `env`, `pwd`): exit statuses, a program that can't start, a crash told apart (signaled), the temporary folder as its working folder, the timeout (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after the grace for one that ignores it; `stop` alone and on an ended program), output read while it runs (300 KB, more than a pipe holds, no stall), the cap and `complete`, output dropped unless kept, a timed-out run's output never returned, the cleaned environment (the provider variables and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR out, the rest kept); the launchers' options (a folder given or inherited, input written and closed, errors kept apart, the poll, the started hook's pid, SIGTERM only with `killAfterGrace` false, an unlimited drain); `RunningProgram`; `ownGroup` (a group of its own, the caller's descriptors closed in it, the whole group killed after the grace or stopped by the poll); and a lint that `Run/` imports Foundation only, never logs and names no app |
| `auth` | ClaudeAuth (`Auth/`, with `Keychain.swift`) compiled against it, Runs and ProfileCore alone, with fakes that stop the run if anything real is asked (no Keychain, no `claude`, no Terminal): the default folder however it is spelled and the Keychain item names (known SHA-256 vectors), the record's place, a run's environment, ready only as a plain folder, each source of an account and the matching rule, the one answer (verified, seat not known, guessed, differs, none) and whose the numbers are, the account rule settled case by case (D1 signed in by an id or an address, with the saved key's address placeholder upgraded; D2 a personal plan and a Team seat on one address as two seats; D3 a verified word over the record, the numbers kept with it; D4 no public name says plainly "in use"; D5 the organisation by its id, else its name in any case) and the risks (a sign-in under a running claude, personal plus Team, a one-sided organisation, an organisation renamed while a process runs, a silent process with the record changed), the saved key and its text, finding accounts on a throwaway home (a folder's record and backups, the Claude Code folders, every home and switch record, the desktop app's sessions, transcripts' ids from their first 64 KB with a FIFO skipped, the sightings put together), the one folder reader (by stamp, a change said once, a parse a write overtook not kept, a FIFO), the stored sign-in reader (none: nil; the Keychain's through a fake `security`, its outcomes and order), the sign-in watch, renew, sign-out, the sign-in script (quoting, the marker, owner only, the watch's files), nothing started on a folder that isn't there, the bounded record read, the real runners' timeouts; and a lint that `Auth/` imports Foundation, CryptoKit, ProfileCore and Runs only, starts no process of its own, never logs, never writes the Keychain, names the Keychain only in `Keychain.swift`, keeps nothing in the preferences but ClaudeSignIn's look at Terminal's, and that `Core/` never imports it |
| `claudesignin` | ClaudeSignIn (`Auth/ClaudeSignIn.swift`, the shared Claude Code sign-in in a Terminal window) with a stand-in Terminal (it runs the window's `.terminal` settings file's command with `/bin/sh`) and a stand-in `claude auth login` (`Checks/claudesignin/bin/claude`; an ad-hoc compiled one, `adhoc.c`, for the environment branch), Terminal's preferences in memory, never the Keychain: the settings file named after the app, its script and the work folder (0700), each outcome (signed in, unverified, wrong account by id and by address and organisation, declined, failed, stopped, timed out), a login still running never ended on a guess, stop and a second start ending the login, the one lock per folder and the process guard, a folder that isn't there or a link, Terminal's kept profiles swept (only this app's work folder, never Terminal's default or startup profile), a script that starts late (a stop before Terminal ran it, an immediate restart, a quit) ended once it shows, its login with it, each run with its own pid, status and refusal files; lints that run first: no Keychain in `ClaudeSignIn.swift` or the suite, every sign-in in the suite handed a Terminal-preferences stand-in; the files' modes (settings file 0600, script 0700) and the login guard's fail-closed path on process tables of the suite's own |
| `nokeychain` | ClaudeAuth built without `Auth/Keychain.swift` and `Auth/DiscoveryApp.swift`, as cl_quick builds it: it compiles, and none of the three libraries calls the Security API, holds the `security` tool's path or `find-generic-password`, or keeps `KeychainSignIn`; and ClaudeAuth holds no session or chat reader (`transcriptAccounts`, `appSessions`, the session folders' names) |
| `addressprivacy` | AddressPrivacy (`Privacy/`) built on its own and the suite compiled against it alone: with the blur on, what is drawn, put in a sentence or spoken is the fixed stand-in or "hidden address" and never any part of the real address (on the strings, and on the views' pixels: the same for two addresses, not blank); with the blur off or on an explicit reveal (the pointer, a peek) the real address; the room is the stand-in's alone; a reveal ends reliably; the setting is a value (prefs-domain keys of both senses through a dictionary, the change note). A lint first: Apple's frameworks only, no logging, no app named, imported by no layer module |

Safety: nothing here reads the real Keychain, Terminal's preferences or a real Claude Code folder, opens a window or
starts a real `claude`; sample addresses only (`example.com`); only processes a suite started are signalled, by their pids.
